name: io.github.JC7333/mandatia
title: AMR (Agent Mandate Registry)
description: Records who authorized an AI agent to do what, until when; signed tokens, hash-chained journal.

environmentVariables.name: AMR_DB_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the SQLite registry file (default: amr_mandates.db in the client's current directory)

environmentVariables.name: AMR_SIGNING_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the registry's Ed25519 private key, created on first use; keep it out of version control

environmentVariables.name: AMR_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the registry's public key file
